With $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='NUL' set for that shell only, run git status --short and git diff --stat

Git global config C:/Users/zeeshan/.gitconfig is unreadable (Permission denied); git commands work only with a per-command env override: $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='NUL' (do NOT modify any git config). .kiro/settings is permission-denied (harmless warning). npm ci needs network access; may fail under sandbox. contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. User rules: small changes, no new deps, show git diff --stat at end, do not push.
key_patterns: Project content lives in constants/projects.ts typed by types/project.ts (Project interface: slug, title, subtitle, logo, description, technologies, features, githubUrl, featured?). Detail pages are generated by app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx via generateStaticParams (dynamicParams=false). Sitemap app/sitemap.ts already maps over all projects, so new projects are included automatically. Homepage FeaturedProjectsSection filters featured and slices 4, rendered through ProjectGrid which is a 2-column grid (sm:grid-cols-2); three featured items leave an orphan card in row 2. Project logos are 64x64 SVGs: <rect rx=14 fill=#e7e5e4/> with centered Arial 24px bold #44403c initials at y=40. Client components start with "use client" (see components/layout/ThemeToggle.tsx). Tailwind utility classes with tokens like border-border, bg-muted, text-muted-foreground, rounded-xl, text-[13px]. Badge falls back to a generic code icon for technologies not in constants/tech-icons.ts, so PowerShell/WPF/XAML/winget need no icon entries. Detail page hardcodes a 'Mobile Project' pill label and a 'View GitHub Profile' button text.
directory_structure: app/ (routes: /, /projects, /projects/[slug], robots.ts, sitemap.ts, not-found.tsx; no /utils route), components/{core,layout,seo,shared,ui}, constants/ (site, profile, projects, tech-icons), lib/, public/ (assets/projects/*.svg, etc.), types/ (project.ts, social.ts)
